save.text: Subscriber giveaway at 4,200 won by LL1973; prize: signed PHB + signed cast photo. Next giveaway at 4,250 and every +50 subs thereafter. (Turn 0-2)
No CR episode next week due to San Diego Comic-Con; panels: Geek & Sundry main panel w/ Laura 1-2pm and Critical Role panel 4-5pm at PetCo Park; panel will be filmed/streamed later. (Turns 6-12)
Matt and Marisha traveling to New Zealand the week after Comic-Con; two-week main-story hiatus planned; other available cast will stream alternate content. (Turn 12)
Intro video failed; cast improvised live intro and then proceeded to start the game. (Turns 75-110)
Sam joined mid-session; asked for recap and then was let in. (Turns 131-140)

Current in-story: Vox Machina are on a skyship crossing to Vasselheim/Othanzia carrying the Horn of Orcus in a holy container; recently fought wyvern/griffin-riding bandits, took a captive, some magic disabled, a few lives lost; journey ~6–7 days, currently a few days in and still airborne. (Turns 130-146,149)
Halfling mage captive: she was bound and locked in the ship's anti-magic brig by Captain Damon after attacking his crew; her future on the ship undecided. (Confirmed by Matt, Turns 155-161)
Voyage status: Vox Machina traveling over the Ozmit Sea toward Vasselheim/Othanzia with the Horn of Orcus secured in a holy container; days have passed and spells have recovered. (Turns 167,224,227)

Grog beard attempts/log: Grog used magic to grow faint translucent facial hair (roll 38); party braided it with beads/flowers; Percy read and others reacted; Liam glued rope goatee onto sleeping Grog and attempted stealth; DM requested a perception check with disadvantage for Grog. (Turns 181-191,197-211,230-236)
Grog's glued rope goatee confirmed present and described: dark brown, braided, 3-4 inches, proud reaction. (Turns 238-244)
Weather changed mid-voyage on day six: sky clouded, colder, slow natural formation (Nature check 20); not an ominous storm but gloomier. (Turns 245-251)
Tiberius and Scanlan trade agreed: Scanlan will trade the circlet for Tiberius's Ioun Stone; Scanlan accepts and they hug. (Turns 257-315)
Ioun Stone now orbits Scanlan's head after trade; effect described as orbit/halo. (Turns 333-340, 346)
Sky grew noticeably chillier and light snow began to fall ahead during voyage. (Turn 350)

Keyleth (Air Ashari) mentioned Fire Ashari tribe in Pyrah (Vasselheim area); she may visit after handling the Horn and must complete Aramente to become headmaster. Last Aramente participant did not return. (Turns 356, 366, 372, 400-402)

Keyleth's mother left when Keyleth was ~5-6 years old; Keyleth doesn't know which Fire Ashari tribe she joined or if she's alive. Party intends to visit Keyleth's homeland and may ask about her. (Turns 408-444, 451-456)

Land sighted: continent Othanzia visible; Vesper Timberland (vast forest) with snowfall; singular mountain spire ~20-30 miles from shore houses a heavily fortified, tiered city larger than Emon with multiple eras of wall construction and dragon-headed ballistae on walls. Kima identified location as Othanzia. (Turns 457, 459-466, 471-476)
Kima anxious about city approach and escorts; she offers to answer questions and indicates escorts will guide them. (Turns 543-546)
Scanlan stored a 3rd-level Lightning Bolt in the Ioun Stone; stone glows greenish-blue though it's a white stone. (Turns 526-538)
(REPLACE) Kima anxious about city approach and escorts; she offers to answer questions and indicates escorts will guide them. Party preparing to disembark; Trinket lowered by crane. (Turns 543-546)
Kima last with her Order 8 years ago; nervous but cordial. (Turn 559, 557)
Scalebearer Yonn: elderly, bald, spectacles, silver/blue robes; identified as escort and seems sincere (Insight: no deception). (Turns 568-571, 600)
Platinum Sanctuary ~25-minute walk from landing; escorts will bring party there; few in city know about Horn—only Kima, the travelers, Yonn, and Highbearer Vord. (Turns 585-587, 609)
Vasselheim described as 'Dawn City', pilgrimage-only access by foot; visible holy symbols on guards mainly of Arathis, Avandra, Melora, Bahamut; none of Sarenrae. (Turn 635-640)

Scalebearer Yonn leads party; comments about dragonborn presence—dragonborn uncommon; remarks on metallic vs chromatic, Tiberius alters appearance to gold and is cautioned to avoid obvious transformations. (Turns 661-659, 655-658)

Party plans rooftop/flank surveillance around box: Key participants—Vex rooftop (failed Stealth 1), Keyleth eagle form aerial support, Grog and Percy on path, Scanlan blending in (Stealth 23), Tiberius rear. Muddy streets, recent sleet, city folk rugged and grizzled. (Turns 665-715)

Platinum Sanctuary: Draconic inscriptions (words like 'honor, justice'); three ivory/silver spires atop fortress; large gray stone double doors with Bahamut shield/dragon-head symbol; doors open automatically for Scalebearers. (Turn 717-758)
Forest near Vasselheim shows large, fast-moving serpentine/multi-bodied creature (possibly hydra); ballistae fired and creature retreated—presented as common occurrence. (Turns 774-816)
City militia called 'Bastions'—volunteer civilian militia comprising ~25% of populace; wear makeshift armor and patrol extensively. (Turns 770-774)
Keyleth left temple through arrow-slit, encountered Platinum Dragon guard; had to Persuade claiming Vox Machina membership; Keyleth perceives trees moving and snowfall obscures view. (Turns 820-846)
Keyleth was cuffed/arrested in temple but Kima vouched for her; cuffs removed and Scalebearers embarrassed (Turns 852-894).
Scalebearer Yonn continues to lead party through plain, ancient-feeling Platinum Sanctuary temple; strong divine hum sensed especially by Pike (Turns 910-931).

Highbearer Vord greets party in central worship chamber; confirms Horn of Orcus in their possession and seals/vanishes the container after divine check. Kima recognized by Vord as disciple. (Turn 934-974)

Temple plans: Hall of the Exalt chosen to seal Horn; Star of Exaltation (Bahamut relic) destroyed ~300 years ago during siege; chamber used for divine rituals; lower chambers infested with subterranean spider creatures; Scalebearer Yonn fled after initiating some vault defenses and remains employed. (Turns 979-997,1000-1009,1018-1031)

Vord's security assurances: temple continuously guarded; if full vault defenses trigger, intruders will be announced; Scalebearers will escort the reliquary into the vault and 'keep them safe' per Vord. (Turns 1024-1031,1026)

Clarification on Star loss: Star of Exaltation was used as a divine focus in a ritual during the War of the Beginnings and Bahamut withdrew its presence—artifact ceased to exist on this plane rather than merely misplaced. (Turns 1034-1044)
Laura used Primeval Awareness to detect dragons within six miles of Vasselheim; result: no dragons detected. (Turn 1050-1052)

Temple of Bahamut offered party 3,000 gp total to deliver and seal the Horn; Highbearer Vord authorized after persuasion/deception by Scanlan and others; Kima objected to taking money but agreed to show them to the vault. (Turns 1093-1131)
Kima accompanies the party to the temple's vault/storage area; party led down two layers into a musty, basement-like storage. (Turns 1130-1139)
Kima dispels hidden wooden illusion by placing holy symbol into recess; reveals stone doorway and staircase into ancient subterranean vault. (Turns 1144-1146)

Room beyond stairs: 50x50 ft, ~20 ft high, filled with white mist emitted from mouths of two dragon-carved pillars; pillars have bases that can pivot/rotate. Gust of Wind cleared center briefly; mist refills quickly. (Turns 1160-1190, 1204)
Party discusses redistributing communication earrings; Vax (Liam) offered to give earrings to Vax, Grog, and Scanlan during exploration. (Turns 1193-1202)

Dragon-mouth mist trap triggered when Vax bumped mist; flames burst—Vax and Tiberius took 12 fire, Scanlan, Keyleth, Pike took 24. Spell concentration active and Keyleth used second slot to clear mist. (Turns 1215-1309)
Tiberius and Scanlan trade agreed: Scanlan will trade the circlet for Tiberius's Ioun Stone; Scanlan accepts and they hug. (Turns 257-315)

Party split briefly: front group (Keyleth, Scanlan, Tiberius, Pike) moved through first; Percy, Grog, Vex and Trinket were behind watching. Scalebearers accompanied party through cleared path. (Turns 1266-1296)
Party encountered rotating pillar trap in circular chamber; Vax used Boots of Haste, triggered pistons; took 40 crushing damage to shoulder blade but survived (Turns 1344-1376).
Vax used Luck twice during trap sequence (Turns 1357, 1367) and succeeded on multiple acrobatics checks (22, then 23).
Room contains multiple pistoning circular platforms that rise to ceiling and rotate; players must make acrobatics/dex saves to traverse (Turns 1327-1332, 1363-1379).
Vax (Liam) dodged, likely broke ribs but escaped toward staircase. (Turn 1387)
Room is a rotating grinding mill with pillars slamming into ceiling; small quarter-sized hole appears intermittently where a pillar hits. (Turns 1390-1406)
Vex (Laura) successfully shot an arrow into the hole with inspiration and advantage effects; attack roll total 35. (Turns 1464-1471)

Vex (Laura) shot arrow into intermittent hole; Matt adjudicated ricochet and arcane force pushed arrow upward causing metal/chunks to pour out; roll by Orion (Vax?) was 17 on follow-up check. (Turns 1471-1484)
Vax (Liam) crossed to other side clutching broken rib, gave half-assed high-five to sister; party preparing short rest. (Turns 1505-1514)
Session paused for a five-minute real-life break; guests introduced (Orion, Taylor); charity/GameChanger mention. (Turns 1516-1552)

Charity guest Taylor (GameChanger) spoke about founding charity after illness; GameChanger collects games, runs hospital GameChanger days, provides scholarships, partnered with Square; donations tonight to GameChanger and donors $>1 get Deus Ex director's cut. (Turn 1556-1563,1569-1576,1589-1596,1598-1601)

Critical Role pledged tonight's donations (portion from 826LA link) to GameChanger; chat/mods have GameChanger command/link; website briefly crashed by traffic; giveaway updates tied to subs/donations. (Turns 1578-1585,1597,1607-1611)
Breaks: show paused for brief break when Taylor finished; Matt resumed and announced prize winner Paula Konito after break. (Turns 1602-1606)
